items.answer: Regulations on baggage allowance are as follows: Vietnam Airlines: 01 pieces of 10kg hand baggage, the dimension must not exceed: 56cm x 36cm x 23cm. 01 checked baggage of 23kg, the dimension must not exceed 158cm. (Except for economy lite class A, P, G departing from Hanoi, Nha Trang, Ho Chi Minh, Van Don, Da Nang)Vietjet Air and Pacific Airlines: Hand baggage: 07 kg, dimension: 56 cm x 36 cm x 23 cm Bamboo Airways: Hand baggage is 07 kg, dimension is 56 cm x 36 cm x 23 cm Checked baggage: 20 kg, total 3 dimensions < 203 cm (except for promotional ticket).Refer to baggage information of airlines:https://www.vietnamairlines.com/vn/vi/travel-information/baggage/baggag…https://www.bambooairways.com/vn-vi/thong-tin-hanh-trinh/thong-tin-hanh…https://www.vietjetair.com/Sites/Web/vi-vn/NewsDetail/dich-vu-hanh-ly/%… check-in?

items.question: Can I bring wine and fish sauce on the plane?
items.answer: Bringing wine and fish sauce on the plane is acceptable. It is necessary to comply with the regulations on concentration, volume, and packaging specifications of airlines. Every single bottle does not exceed 1L capacity include detailed brand labels. For more information, contact the hotline 0987 328 681 or email onlineticket@vinpearl.com.

items.question: What if I lost my luggage during/ after the flight?
items.answer: As soon as you recognize your baggage is lost, please notify the airline baggage department at the airport for tracking and compensation.

items.question: What benefits do customers enjoy? Where to join the VinClub membership card program?
items.answer: Depending on the card level, customers will have different incentives. Customers can refer to the website for details on card level benefits and applicable systems: https://www.vinpearl.com/vi/vinclub.

items.question: What is the difference between a physical card and an online one?
items.answer: An online card is attached to the customer's profile on the MyVinpearl app, functioning as a physical card. Vinpearl encourages customers to use online cards for enhanced convenience.

items.question: Can I own more than 01 VinClub card?
items.answer: Each customer owns only one (01) card number code.

items.question: When can I use the card benefits after registering as a member?
items.answer: - For online account registration via Website/App: customers can use the benefits of Pearl member right after the successful registration. - For customers buying VIP Pearl premium cards: the account will be activated 03 working days after registering for card activation. Customers can log in for the online card to use the benefits immediately.

items.question: Can I check the usage status history transaction of my card?
items.answer: Customers can check the card transaction history directly on My Vinpearl application through VinClub Members section.

items.question: When can I be upgraded to higher membership tier?
items.answer: Membership card can be upgraded in the following cases: - Customers accumulate enough transaction value to satisfy the upgrade conditions: + Reach to 50 million VND accumulated value: Platinum Member + Reach to 100 million VND cumulative value: Diamond Member + Customers will upgrade as soon as they accumulate enough transaction value in the calendar year (from January 1 to December 31)

items.question: Why is the transaction showing up in the transaction history but not in the accumulated history?
items.answer: As soon as the customers successfully place the online service, the transaction will display in the Transaction History section. After the Customer finishes using the service, the transaction will display in the Accumulated history section

items.question: Can I accumulate the value of nights purchased through Vinpearl travel agents?
items.answer: Accumulated value only applies when customers book directly with Vinpearl.

items.question: Can I apply the member's privileges for room-related surcharges incurred after booking accommodation through Vinpearl's travel agency? How can I get the offers?
items.answer: We are sorry. The room-related surcharges do not apply in this case. However, member benefits apply to all other services at the properties.

items.question: In 01 year if I have no transaction, will my account be deactivated?
items.answer: The customer's account will not be deactivated but will be maintained at the lowest membership tier, which is the Member tier.

items.question: Why is the card validity not printed on the physical card? How to check card validity?
items.answer: For checking the expiry date of the VinClub card, please visit our website Vinpearl.com or MyVinpearl application then follow the below steps: - Sign in your account - Access "Account" section

items.question: How and where to use benefits when join-in the VinClub membership program?
items.answer: Customers may own different benefits depending on the membership tier. Please kindly check out more detail at: https://www.vinpearl.com/en/vinclub.

items.question: How to redeem complimentary night (s)?
items.answer: Please sign in on the Vinpearl Website/ MyVinpearl Application and follow the below steps: - Check out "My benefits" in the Account section - Choose "Complimentary night" and redeem click - Select the property, number of guests, check-in/ out date - The complimentary night will display at "0 VND" for App and "1 VND" for the website - Select the room type, package, and reserve booking.

items.question: Are the complimentary night(s) applied at all Vinpearl properties?
items.answer: The complimentary night (s) are not applied at Luxury properties and during peak season (following each property's policy)

items.question: What type of room does the complimentary night apply to the card owners? And how many people for maximum?
items.answer: - The complimentary night would only apply to the Standard room and can be upgraded upon availability. Customers can pay extra for a guaranteed upgrade. - The complimentary night is applied to a maximum of 2 adults and 02 children under 04 years olds.

items.question: Does the customer need to pay any surcharges for an extra person or seasonality when using complimentary night(s)?
items.answer: The customer would pay for additional surcharges and get discounts base on the membership tier. Please provide the reservation number and Member ID to the hotline agent or present your card to the receptionist for benefit redemption.

items.question: How many rooms can I reserve using member's benefits?
items.answer: Vinpearl does not limit the number of rooms to be booked by the member. However, the member needs to present at the time of using services.

items.question: Do my member benefits apply to Minibar, Room service?
items.answer: We are regret. The member benefit would only apply to dining at restaurants.

items.question: Why does my membership not include complimentary night(s)?
items.answer: Complimentary night would only apply to: - Customers who accumulate enough transaction value and are upgraded before 08/08/2024 - VIP customers are given cards depending on each program

items.question: Are there any Vinpearl properties (such as restaurants, nightclubs, etc) not accepting VinClub cards?
items.answer: Customers can use the VinClub card to get discounts for services at all facilities of the Vinpearl Hotel chain. However, the membership benefits are not applicable to: - Alcohol products - Almaz Phu Quoc - Peak season according to the Hotel's information For details, please see the "VinClub applicable services" section on the Vinpearl website.

items.question: How to get the transaction value accumulated when I book services using the membership card?
items.answer: Customers can accumulate 100% of the transaction value after the discount for the services provided by Vinpearl. Other services do not include in the accumulated value provided by Vinpearl's partners

items.question: Can the cardholder accumulate transaction value of services not applied membership discount for membership tier maintenance in the following year?
items.answer: Yes, you can. All online or on-site transactions placing directly with Vinpearl are eligible for accumulation and used to qualify for the membership tier. Note: Not applicable to products/services provided by other suppliers such as air tickets, tours, etc.

items.question: If I am given a card, will it be automatically renewed? If not, what do I need to do to maintain the card after 1 year?
items.answer: The system relies on the accumulated transaction value of the customer's spending in the most recent calendar year to determine the card's rank after the gift card expires. Customers must make enough transactions according to the card's conditions to continue maintaining the card.

items.question: Can the VinClub card be used in conjunction with other offers?
items.answer: Hotel and entertainment services: customers can get discounts on the best rates, including promotional prices. Other services included golf, F&B services...: Not applicable with other promotions.

items.question: Can family members or friends share a membership?
items.answer: Membership benefits are only applicable to the presence of the cardholders.

items.question: Does the complimentary airport pickup have any limitations? What type of vehicle is allowed for transportation?
items.answer: The complimentary airport pickup service is only applicable to customers having Diamond cards when booking at Vinpearl with: - Unlimited times to apply - Only applicable for properties providing airport shuttle service - Shuttle bus

items.question: How can I use the early check-in and late check-out benefits?
items.answer: Early check-in and late check-out will be subject to actual room availability. If the properties have available rooms, customers can check in early after 10 am and late check-out before 4 pm.

items.question: If I pay for my booking by bank transfer, can I earn points? If yes, who/how should I contact?
items.answer: If you pay for the booking by bank transfer to Vinpearl, the front desk will accumulate the booking value to the customer's account at the time of check-out.

items.question: When checking in or using F&B, Spa, Golf benefits.., do the cardholder need to present the physical card?
items.answer: The cardholder presents the physical card or the online card (on the MyVinpearl app) at the front desk or service points along with an identification document proving membership card ownership (with the same name as the cardholder) upon arrival to enjoy the privileges. Cardholders who have updated their profile picture on the app for authentication do not need to present identification.

items.question: I have already registered and paid the fee, can I cancel, transfer or modify the information cardholder?
items.answer: We are sorry. But the card, which successfully has registered and paid for, will not be refunded or transferred in any case.

items.question: How many days in advance should the cardholder register use the complimentary night offer?
items.answer: The customer has to register at least 03 days in advance for the best support. The notice: To proactively choose the desired period of stay, please make a reservation on the website vinpearl.com or MyVinpearl application.

items.question: The cardholder books the complimentary night but is not present at check-in time, is the free night benefit still applied? - If not applicable, at what price will the customer pay? - Will the cardholder complimentary night become invalid?
items.answer: As stated in the regulation, the Cardholder is required to stay. In case the Cardholder is not present at check-in time, the complimentary night benefit will not apply.

items.question: I have made my reservations before activating my membership card. So, can I cancel my booking to re-book and accumulate bonus points?
items.answer: All reservations have a cancellation policy included. Customers can double-check in the booking confirmation email.

items.question: Can I use the privileges of the VinClub card for relatives or friends when they use the Swimming, Spa, Gym service... ? Can they use it without the cardholder's presence?
items.answer: The cardholder need to present when using service

items.question: I make a reservation for a group using my privileges, can the group bring along my physical card and my identification document?
items.answer: No. You can. The number of rooms booked under the benefits members is not limited, but members need to be present when using the service.

items.question: Will the group be surcharged for the discount applied? In this case, I make a reservation by using my privileges, my room is not canceled, but I can't check in with the group.
items.answer: The group will pay the difference amount between the public rate and discount rate.

items.question: Can I accumulate the points the next day If I forget to bring my card when using the service?
items.answer: Unfortunately, the accumulation of transactions is only processed when the owner shows the card. Please kindly install the MyVinpearl application to use the card online without a physical card.

items.question: Nếu quên không mang theo thẻ khi sử dụng dịch vụ, tôi có được tích điểm bù vào ngày hôm sau không?
items.answer: Rất tiếc, việc tích lũy giao dịch chỉ áp dụng cho Khách hàng có xuất trình thẻ. Khách hàng có thể cài ứng dụng My Vinpearl để sử dụng thẻ trực tuyến mà không cần mang theo thẻ vật lý.

items.question: Can a foreigner own a VinClub card?
items.answer: The membership card can issue to all customers living in Vietnam, including foreigners who hold Vietnam residence cards.

items.question: The discount benefit for the MICE group to book meetings is a company's privilege, but the card issues only for individual customers, so how is this benefit applied?
items.answer: The card is only issued for individual customers, not for the company. In case the customer uses the card to book events or conferences, the cardholder must be present. The discount is only applied for F&B service and not for setting-up service like AV system, flowers,...

items.question: When booking via hotline under the discount/complimentary privileges, do cardholders need to send a photo of the card or just provide the card number for staff to check, verify and confirm the benefits included?
items.answer: Customers provide the card number and cardholder's name. Our consultants will check the information and assist with service booking. When customers check-in at the property, please show a physical card or an online card with an identification document for the receptionist to verify. If the customer cannot present all the documents, the customer will pay the difference between public rate and membership discount rate.

items.question: What is VinClub?
items.answer: VinClub is the Vingroup's Loyalty Program, offering many top-class privileges to customers.

items.question: Who can become a member of VinClub?
items.answer: All customers who have transactions in the Vingroup ecosystem (buying Vinhomes houses, buying VinFast cars, traveling to Vinpearl, taking XanhSM taxis, going to Vinschool, getting medical treatment at Vinmec, renting Vincom Retail booths or having children studying at VinUni will be deployed after 08/08) can join VinClub and accumulate VPoints (depending on membership level).

items.question: Do foreign VinClub members enjoy full benefits and incentives?
items.answer: Foreigners enjoy full benefits and incentives, applicable in Vietnam.

items.question: How to register and log in to VinClub?

items.question: VinClub membership levels?
items.answer: VinClub has 4 levels: Member - Gold - Platinum - Diamond

items.question: What information is required for customers to provide when registering for membership?
items.answer: Minimum required information for membership includes: (1) Full name, (2) Email or Phone number

items.question: Can customers edit their registered personal information?
items.answer: Customers can only edit the following information: Gender, address. For other information, customers need to contact customer service for support.

items.question: Where can I find official information about VinClub?
items.answer: Official information about VinClub is available at: vinclub.vn, Fanpage: VinClub, Hotline: 1900 232389 - extension 2

items.question: What is brand linking?
items.answer: Customers with email/phone number registered with member companies in Vingroup ecosystem can link brands to unify VinClub card level.

items.question: How to link a brand?
items.answer: Step 1: Go to the account screen Step 2: Click on "Link brand account" in the Settings menu Step 2: Enter the email/phone number that registered the account with the brand Step 4: Enter the OTP verification code for the phone number/email just entered Step 5: Confirm the link & link the brand successfully

items.question: VinClub membership ranking principles?
items.answer: See details at: https://vinclub.vn/ or contact hotline 1900 232389 extension 2

items.question: Can customers buy Gold/ Platinum/ Diamond cards?
items.answer: No, customers need to spend and accumulate transactions to upgrade the card level.

items.question: Is VinWonders Phu Quoc free-open to guests staying at Vinpearl Hotel?
items.answer: Vinpearl has a variety of room packages included or excluded in VinWonders tickets. Please check your confirmation letter for more details. In case you would like to book VinWonders tickets. Contact our hotline 1900232389 or hotel reception for further assistance.

items.question: How do I check-in my online ticket?
items.answer: VinWonder ticket is bookable on our VinWonder's website. A valid QR code will automatically send to your email after payment success. Please use a QR code to check-in at the ticket counter of VinWonders Phu Quoc.

items.question: What theme parks are in VinWonders Phu Quoc?
items.answer: Upon visiting VinWonders Phu Quoc - Vietnam's largest theme park, you will be immersed in 06 subdivisions and 12 unique themes that offer visitors captivating stories, unparalleled adventures and thrilling games. - European Streetmosphere - Medieval Europe - Fairy World - Mysterious Viking Village - Neptune - Adventure World - Typhoon World

items.question: Can I bring my own food into VinWonders Phu Quoc?
items.answer: Because of food safety and preserving the landscape environment, please DO NOT bring the outside food into VinWonders Phu Quoc. We have optional restaurants offering a buffet, a la carte, fast food, beverages… to accommodate all your requests.

items.question: Does VinWonders Phu Quoc provide a round-trip shuttle bus?
items.answer: We provide shuttle service from and to VinWonders Phu Quoc as the following routes: - Route 1: Tran Hung Dao street - 30/4 street - Hung Vuong street - Route 2: Ganh Dau - Duong Dong Please kindly contact hotline 19006677 - ext 2 for more assistance.

items.answer: We regret to inform you that prepaid tickets are non-refundable in any case of amendment/cancellation.

items.question: How do I get an offer for local residents?
items.answer: VinWonders Phu Quoc offers special deal for residents located at Kien Giang province or some listed provinces. Please present valid identity document at ticket counter such as ID card, driver license, student card required for visitors above 140cm and birth certificate for children under 140cm.

items.question: Can I fly a drone in Grand World Phu Quoc?
items.answer: The surrounding area of Grand World Phu Quoc is equipped with a flycam disabling system by the Ministry of National Defence. Please provide a valid license issued by the Ministry of National Defence and approval of Grand World's Management Team to fly a drone inside this area. Otherwise, DO NOT fly a drone inside this area to avoid missing or broken equipment.

items.question: Can I bring my pet into Grand World Phu Quoc?
items.answer: Pets or other live animals are not allowed inside the Grand World Phu Quoc.

items.question: Do I need to pay any additional fee at VinWonders Phu Quoc?
items.answer: You can enjoy all shows, entertainment, amusement and performances inside VinWonders Phu Quoc without an additional fee service. Please kindly settle by your own account for food, shopping, locker rental, towel rental, electric car rental and other add-on services.

items.question: What kind of tickets and fares at VinWonders Nha Trang are?
items.answer: VinWonders Nha Trang offers a ticket package which is included cable car tickets, Indoor & Outdoor games, Water Park, Aquarium, Quy Vuong garden, Van Hoa hill, shows, and performances. However, this ticket is excluded from the water sport games and your services such as food service, shopping, locker rental, towel rental, and other convenient services. Please contact hotline 19006677 - ext 1 for more assistance.

items.question: What is the timetable of VinWonders Nha Trang and the carble car?
items.answer: VinWonders Nha Trang opens daily from 8AM to 8PM. For more details, please find out activities and performances schedules here https://vinpearl.com/en/vinwonder-playground/nha_trang.

items.question: How do I get to VinWonders Nha Trang?
items.answer: VinWonders Nha Trang is located in Hon Tre Island. We serve cable car service instead of canoe or speedboat from the mainland to VinWonders. Therefore, please visit our Cable car station south of Cau Da Pier, Vinh Nguyen ward, Nha Trang city. Please be noted in case of high traffic of cable car, we may open the free speedboat and keep you notice on it.

items.question: Does VinWonders Nha Trang provide shuttle bus?
items.answer: No. We doesn't. The shuttle bus service is not available at the moment. Thus we would like to suggest you choose another vehicle as to the following: - Option 1: By bus No. 4: Hon Xen - Nguyen Thien Thuat - Vinpearl. - Option 2: By taxi to VinWonders Nha Trang Cable car station.

items.question: How to buy the ticket for a group or become VinWonders' ticket agency?
items.answer: Regarding this special request, please contact our Sale Team via 02583 888 886 for further assistance.

items.question: Does VinWonders Nha Trang have restaurant or food-court?
items.answer: VinWonder has many restaurants with several menu variations that meet your needs. Here is a list of options throughout the park for your choice: - Wind & Sea Restaurant serves a set menu. - Coral Restaurant serves a lunch buffet. - Chingu Restaurant serves Korean grill & hotpot. - A chain of restaurants and fast food courters.

items.question: Where is the Lost and Found counter?
items.answer: Our VinWonders Lost & Found counter is located on the mainland. Please quick contact to our nearest security staff or Hotline 19006677 (ext 1) for further assistance.

items.question: How do feedback to VinWonders Nha Trang?
items.answer: To improve the services, we are looking forward to your valuable feedback via Hotline 19006677 (ext 1) or email we-care@vinwonders.com.

items.question: What is one-way and round trip ticket?
items.answer: VinWonders Nha Trang offers two types of tickets as the following: - One-way ticket: Customer checks in the island by your arrangement and buy the ticket on spot. Then checking out to the mainland by cable car. - Round trip ticket: Customer transfers both ways by cable car. Kindly be also informed that the ticket can be redeemed one-time only.

items.question: Do I need the ticket to play all games?
items.answer: VinWonders Nha Trang offers a ticket package. And this entrance ticket will be collected upon check-in at the cable car to the island; when they have passed the amusement park, guests are free to join all games and will return to the mainland without tickets.

items.question: How can I change the online tickets?
items.answer: VinWonder Nha Trang ticket is bookable on our Vinpearl website. A valid QR code will be automatically sent to your email after payment success. Please show your QR code to check in at the ticket counter of VinWonders Nha Trang. Kindly note that this one-time ticket is valid within registered time. Children's height may be checked upon check-in.

items.question: What are the fees of storage and rental services?
items.answer: Our lockers are available inside the Water Park with the below services: - Towel rental service: VND 30,000 per item. Please available deposit VND 150,000 per item. - Locker rental service is VND 20,000/locker. Please available deposit VND 100,000 per locker. - Valuables storage service (with sealing at the reception counter) is VND 10,000 (seals kept at Reception). Please available deposit VND 100,000 per locker. Besides, kindly leave your oversized luggage on the mainland. We keep it for free at our cable car station.

items.question: Is it compulsory to wear a swimsuit/swimwear when playing at the Water Park or Floating Bay?
items.answer: For your most convenient as well as safety reason, swimsuits/swimwear are recommended. A T-shirt without a button or zipper may be accepted. And please avoid wearing khaki, denim, and hard-wearing fabric.

items.question: Can I bring my own baby food into VinWonders Nha Trang?
items.answer: Please be informed that the baby food/baby formula or food prescription is acceptable to bring in with a limited portion.

items.question: Can I use bought ticket for other date?
items.answer: Unfortunately, the bought tickets cannot be refund or alert

items.question: How to buy an entrance ticket to VinWonders Nam Hoi An?
items.answer: Customers can buy tickets directly at the VinWonders Nam Hoi An's ticket counter in the main gate or via the website: Vinpearl.com For group booking requests (above 10 pax). Contact hotline 19006677 (ext 5) or sales department's phone number: 0931122037 for assistance

items.question: What does the ticket price include?
items.answer: The ticket price includes sightseeing and plays zones in all areas: Water Park, River Safari, Folklore Island, indoor and outdoor games area, and shows during the days The ticket price does not include shopping, dining, or other arising services such as electric car rental, locker rental, towel rental, etc.

items.question: What are the ticket prices for travel agencies and agents?
items.answer: The Amusement Park has ticket prices applicable to travel agencies and agencies that have signed contracts with VWNHA. Contact Tel: 0931 122 037 for assistances

items.question: How to redeem free of charge ticket for Vinpearl staff?
items.answer: Please bring an ID of yourself and your family (if any) and present the employee code at the cashier's front desk. You should check in advance with your facility's human resources department to sure that your relative's information has been updated on the corporation's human resources system..

items.question: Does the amusement park have its own ticket for the Safari area? What is the price?
items.answer: Currently, the amusement park does not have individual tickets to visit each zone. You buy an entrance ticket that includes sightseeing and entertainment in all areas (except for shopping, dining or other arising services). Note: • Tickets are valid for use on the day • Ticket price includes 10% VAT • Offer until 31/08/2021 • Not applicable at the same time with promotions in the same invoice

items.question: Does the play area have specific support for people with disabilities?
items.answer: We regret it. There are no specific policies for people with disabilities at the moment.

items.question: Does the Amusement Park have a storage area for customers ?
items.answer: You can leave your items at the drop-off counter close to the main gate or the water park with a deposit fee of 20,000 VND/box.

items.question: Will I have to pay extra when participating in shows/tours at the amusement park?
items.answer: No, the entrance fee includes all activities and shows in the amusement park.

items.question: What time is the opening of the Amusement Park?
items.answer: VWNHA Amusement Park is open from 9:00 to 19:40 every day of the week. Please Note: The closing or opening hours can change depending on each period to suit the customer's needs. And it is constantly updated by us on the amusement park's fan page.

items.question: Can I bring food and drink to the VWNHA?
items.answer: Please do not bring food and drinks from outside into the Amusement Park. Except: porridge, milk for the baby, the dieter has a doctor's prescription.

items.question: What kind of food is served at VWNHA Amusement Park?
items.answer: The Amusement Park has many restaurants like a food court, set menu, à la carte such as Habor Corner Restaurant, Deland, Que market, Food court VinWonders, etc. The prices ranging from 60,000 - 250,000 VND/pax. In addition, the amusement park serves some snacks such as popcorn, ice cream, hot dogs, drinks in the fast-food stalls.

items.question: Can I have VAT invoice for Amusement Park tickets?
items.answer: The Amusement Park has an electronic VAT invoice. Customers can register to write invoices at the cashier's front desk. Invoices need to be registered, written on the day of service use, and received via the registered email address within 3-5 working days.

items.question: Can I buy an entrance ticket after 5pm?
items.answer: Yes. You can refer to the ticket price after 5 pm as follows: - Customers are children with a height from 100cm to under 140cm and people over 60 years old with accompanying identification documents: 310,000 VND - Customers who are adults and children with a height of 140cm or more: 410,000 VND However, customers should consider buying tickets after 5 pm because sightseeing and entertainment activities will be limited: River Safari and Folklore Island close at 5 pm, Water Park closes at 6 pm.

items.question: Is there a swimwear policy when participating in the water park?
items.answer: Yes. Customers who participate in the water park must wear swimwear, not acceptable jeans, khakis, or buttoned items…

items.question: How to use the tram and stroller/wheelchair/parachute rental services?
items.answer: Tram service operates from 9:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., customers who need to use the car can contact the customer service counter near the main gate or hotline: 0931122027 for advice and use the tram service and pram/ wheelchair/ parachute rental services.

items.question: Is there a shuttle bus from DaNang city/Hoian ancient town to the Amusement Park?
items.answer: Yes. The shuttle bus service can change from time to time to suit the demand of customers. You can contact LTT staff: 1900 6677 (press 5) for more information about the bus schedule.

items.question: Is there a room for the guide?
items.answer: Yes. The room for the guide locates near the main gate. Contact the staff at the main gate for instructions.

items.question: What shows are there during the day?
items.answer: There are fabulous main shows during the day in Vinpear Hoi An such as Real scene show “Returning to the Wharf, 3D Mapping Show, Water Music Show, in addition, there are other mini shows...

items.question: Can we rent strollers/wheelchairs or umbrellas at Safari?
items.answer: Strollers/Wheelchairs/Umbrellas are available to rent for usage at Safari's Entrance Gate Umbrella: 30.000 VND / unit, 200.000 VND deposit - Baby stroller: 100.000 VND / unit, 500.000 VND deposit. Note that the baby limit is 12kg. - wheelchair: free, deposit 500,000 VND.

items.question: How I can buy online tickets?
items.answer: Tickets can purchase online at the Website vinpearl.com. The tickets will send to the email provided. The customer can use them through the control gate without needing to changing them into a paper ticket.

items.question: What kind of documents do I need to present when buying tickets for the senior?
items.answer: Seniors over the age of 60 and over can get discount tickets, given that a valid identification document is present at the ticket counter. Vinpearl Safari accepts a photocopy of the identification document with enough information.

items.question: Does Vinpearl Safari have specials support for people with disabilities?
items.answer: Currently, Vinpearl Safari does not have a policy for people with disabilities. However, the park has a specials price policy that applies to children and the elderly.

items.question: Does Vinpearl Safari have a locker room?
items.answer: Vinpearl Safari's Locker room are available for daily rental in the main lobby.

items.question: What kind of payment methods are accepted at the ticket counter?
items.answer: Vinpearl Safari accepts many forms of payment such as cash, credit card, VinID focal point, etc.

items.question: What has been included in ticket fares?
items.answer: The standard ticket included a free sightseeing bus in the semi-wild area, the pedestrian zone - Zoo, free storage, animal shows, Zulu dance and other shows/events free upon availability.

items.question: How often does the bus in the semi-wild area have a trip?
items.answer: Minimum 5 minutes and maximum 15 minutes, there is a bus travelling in the semi-wild area and Vinpearl safari will arrange to increase the number of sightseeing buses depends on the number of visitors.

items.question: Is photography allowed?
items.answer: Photography and videography are permitted without a flashlight. Commercial photography, video shooting or flycam is not permitted without permission from the Safari management.

items.question: What are the operating hours of Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc?
items.answer: Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc opens from 09:00 to 16:00. The last bus in the semi-wildlife area departs at 15:20. Vinprearl Safari will open earlier and close later on public holidays, New Year's and peak seasons. The operating time will update continuously at the Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc fanpage.

items.question: Is there any restaurant serving food inside Vinpearl Safari?
items.answer: Currently, Vinpearl Safari PQ is operating 03 restaurants: - The Rhino and Flamingo Restaurants near the main gate serves a la carte menu. - The Giraffe restaurant at the semi-wild area serves fast food In addition, there are fast food stalls and vending machines located in Vinpearl Safari.

items.question: Can we bring outside food into the safari park?
items.answer: Outside Food and drinks do not permit into the park except Baby food, milk, water. Others food will store at the entrance.

items.question: Can I bring my pet into the park?
items.answer: Pets or other animals are not allowed inside the Vinpearl Safari

items.question: How long does it take to visit all Vinpearl Safari?
items.answer: The time to visit Vinpearl Safari is flexible, depends on the individual demand of each guest. The minimum time you should arrange to visit the safari is 2.5 hours. If you have plenty of time, you should spend all day with your family visiting and exploring the stunning animals in the safari. Vinpearl Safari has 02 zones: - Open Zoo is designed to walk freely with a total area of 80ha (we offer tram service with the charge for guests in need) - Semi-wild area - Safari: sightseeing on the dedicated bus for free from 25 - 30 minutes.

items.question: What is the zoo tram service in Vinpearl Safari PQ?
items.answer: Zoo tram is an additional service at the pedestrian zone with the below fare: - Customers from 100cm tall - under 140cm: 80,000 VND - Customers from 140cm and above: 100,000 VND - Customers under 100cm: free of charge Trams will run around the pedestrian zone, stopping at kid zoo, elephant and lemur stations. You can hop on and off at these 03 stations, and the ticket is unlimited.

items.question: Are there extra charges for any of the attractions inside Safari?
items.answer: All attractions are included in your admission ticket.

items.question: Does Safari provide free transfer services?
items.answer: Vinpearl Safari offers a shuttle bus complimentary from Phu Quoc Central to Vinwonders and vice versa. The bus schedule will be subject to change without notice. Please do contact hotline 19006677(ext 4) for more detail.

items.question: Can I visit Safari when it's heavy rains?
items.answer: You can still visit the park when it rains. In case of heavy rain, the park will have a free tram to assist customers in entering the semi-wild area. In case of light rain, customers can rent an umbrella to walk around or use the electric car service for a fee at the zoo walking area.

items.question: Can I visit Safari first when I haven't done the check-in procedure at Vinpearl Hotel Phu Quoc?
items.answer: Please complete the check-in procedure at the hotel before visiting Safari to have facial recognition image data through the control gate.
